list.title: Seoul hidden gems starter map
list.desc: A free starter map made by PinWith for r/seoulhiddengem: quieter alleys, viewpoints and neighbourhoods beyond the usual list. Add your own finds or co-edit with friends.

items.title: Seochon alleys (서촌)
items.memo: Residential hanok lanes west of Gyeongbokgung; no single entrance, just wander

items.title: Suseong-dong Valley (수성동계곡)
items.memo: Rocky stream valley at the foot of Inwangsan; toilets and a store at the entrance

items.title: Yun Dong-ju Literary Museum (Buam-dong)
items.memo: Free small museum on the Buam-dong pass; closed Mondays

items.title: Ihwa Mural Village (이화마을)
items.memo: Hillside murals and cafes; people live here, keep quiet; many murals have faded

items.title: Naksan Fortress Wall Trail (낙산성곽길)
items.memo: City-wall walk with night lighting; steep in parts, not stroller friendly

items.title: Changsin Quarry Observatory (창신동)
items.memo: Cafe with rooftop view over an old quarry; buy a drink to go up; closed Mon

items.title: Seoullo 7017
items.memo: Elevated walkway over the tracks by Seoul Station; open 24h, nicer at night

items.title: Jeongdong-gil (정동길)
items.memo: Historic street with modern-era buildings; ginkgo-yellow in autumn

items.title: Deoksugung stone-wall road (덕수궁 돌담길)
items.memo: Lit stone-wall path that loops toward Gwanghwamun

items.title: Jeongdong Observatory
items.memo: Free view over Deoksugung from the Seosomun city-hall building; weekdays from 13:30

items.title: Haebangchon Sinheung Market (해방촌)
items.memo: Covered market with small eateries; Namsan Tower views; steep narrow streets

items.title: Mullae Art Village (문래창작촌)
items.memo: Metal workshops mixed with street art and bars; quieter art vibe on weekends

items.title: Seonyudo Park (선유도공원)
items.memo: Old water-treatment plant turned garden island; open 06:00-24:00
